visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two individuals, a woman with long dark hair and glasses in a grey top, and a man with short hair and glasses in a tan shirt, are seated behind a light wood table in a brightly lit indoor living room. In the background, a white cat rests on a wooden shelf unit. The woman waves enthusiastically toward the camera while looking directly at the lens. (2) The woman lifts a small wooden tray containing three white cans with blue and red labeling and a small blue pouch. The man stands slightly behind her, gesturing with his hands towards the products. The setting remains stable with natural, soft interior lighting highlighting the product textures. (3) A close-up shot features a white, T-shaped plastic tool being held up by a hand against the backdrop of the two presenters. The tool has the words 'LADY FLAVOR' engraved on the handle. The camera focuses on the sleek, matte finish and the unique ergonomic shape of the tool's head. (4) Sequential close-up shots display three different pet food cans. The labels feature minimalist designs with fish icons and specific Chinese text. The lighting is bright and even, emphasizing the clean packaging design. A hand rotates the cans slightly to show the full labels clearly to the viewer. (5) A can is shown being opened by the white tool. The tool's edge hooks under the metal tab and lifts it, protecting the user's fingers. The camera captures the detailed movement of the metal lid prying open, revealing a smooth, pinkish-brown meat mousse inside the can. (6) The white tool is used to scoop the meat out onto a shallow ceramic plate. The wide, flat head of the tool efficiently carves out large portions of the soft meat. Close-ups show the tool scraping the inner corners of the metal can, demonstrating its precise fit and scraping capability. (7) Two cats, one ginger-and-white and one tortoiseshell, are shown eating the prepared food from separate plates. The food is topped with a fine, light-colored nutritional powder. The camera uses a macro lens to focus on the cats' tongues and faces as they lap up the mousse. (8) The video returns to the two presenters at the table. The woman holds the white tool and points to it while smiling warmly at the camera. The man gestures toward the cans on the tray. A final pink screen with white centered text appears at the very end.

It uses an enthusiastic presentation followed by a physical demonstration of the tool's efficiency and the cats' enjoyment to drive consumer interest.
